title: Kaveri Polymers v. Pollution Control Committee

brief.about: The appeal challenges a closure direction dated 06.01.2025 issued on the ground that the appellant's effluent treatment plant was found non-functional. The appellant says the plant was under scheduled maintenance for 48 hours.
brief.last: The joint inspection could not be held as the respondent's laboratory was not available. The respondent is directed to carry out the inspection within four weeks and file the report with sample analysis. The interim order shall continue.

orders.summary: The appeal challenges a closure direction dated 06.01.2025 issued on the ground that the appellant's effluent treatment plant was found non-functional. The appellant says the plant was under scheduled maintenance for 48 hours. Issue notice.
